contractingParties.title: Contracting parties
contractingParties.body: These terms govern the relationship between the Vigor Fructus online store (hereinafter: the "Seller") and the website user, i.e. the customer ordering products through the website. By using the website and confirming an order, the user confirms they are familiar with these terms and accepts them in full.

subjectAndScope.title: Subject and scope
subjectAndScope.body: These terms apply to use of the website and purchase of Vigor Fructus products through online ordering. Products offered are dehydrated fruit intended for consumption, serving and use in drink preparation.

pricingAndPayment.title: Pricing and payment
pricingAndPayment.body: All prices are shown in Serbian dinars (RSD), including VAT, unless stated otherwise. Delivery costs are charged separately and clearly shown before order confirmation. Available payment methods are displayed during checkout.

orderingAndContractConclusion.title: Ordering and contract conclusion
orderingAndContractConclusion.body: By clicking the order confirmation button, the customer submits a binding purchase request. The contract is considered concluded when the customer receives confirmation that the order has been accepted. The Seller reserves the right to reject an order in case of price error, stock unavailability or technical error.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: Delivery is performed within the Republic of Serbia within the timeframes shown during purchase. The period may be extended during high order volume periods or due to force majeure. The customer must provide accurate delivery details.

liabilityLimitation.title: Limitation of liability
liabilityLimitation.body: The website is used at your own risk. The Seller is not responsible for temporary website unavailability, technical interruptions, nor for the content and availability of external links. Product photos are informative; minor differences in color and details compared to the actual product are possible.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: All content on the website (texts, photos, visual identity, logos and design) is owned by the Seller or used on an appropriate legal basis and may not be used without prior written consent.

amendments.title: Amendments to terms
amendments.body: The Seller may periodically update these terms to align with business operations and applicable regulations. The updated version applies from the moment it is published on the website.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.body: The customer has the right to withdraw from the purchase within 14 days of receiving the shipment, without stating a reason, in accordance with the applicable consumer protection law.

conditions.title: Return conditions
conditions.body: The returned product should be unopened, unused and, whenever possible, in its original packaging. The customer bears the return shipping cost, except when an incorrect or defective product has been delivered.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.body: If the product is damaged, delivered incorrectly, or does not match the order, the customer may file a complaint. The request should include the order number, a description of the issue and, if possible, photos of the product/package.

responseDeadline.title: Response deadline
responseDeadline.body: The seller confirms receipt of the complaint without delay and responds within the statutory deadline. Once the complaint is confirmed as justified, the customer may be entitled to a replacement product, refund, or another legal remedy.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.body: Refunds are made using the same payment method used for the purchase, unless the customer and seller agree otherwise. The refund is processed after the returned goods are received or after proof is provided that the goods were sent back.

contact.title: Returns and complaints contact
contact.prefix: You can send your request to
contact.suffix: with relevant order information. If needed, our team will provide next steps and the return address.

s1.title: 1. General information
s1.body: Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains which data we collect, why we process it, how long we keep it and what rights you have as a data subject. This policy applies to the use of the Vigor Fructus website and online ordering.

s2.title: 2. Controller and contact
s2.prefix: The data controller is Vigor Fructus, as the service provider through this website. For questions regarding data processing and exercising your rights, you can contact us at

s3.title: 3. Legal bases and processing purposes
s3.body: We process data based on: (a) contract performance (order processing and delivery), (b) legal obligations (accounting and tax regulations), (c) legitimate interest (website security, abuse prevention, business analytics), and (d) consent when required (e.g. marketing communications).

s4.title: 4. Data we collect
s4.body: Depending on how you use the website, we may collect: full name, email address, phone number, delivery address, order details and technical data necessary for website operation (e.g. IP address, device type, cookies). We do not store card payment data in our system when payment is processed through an external payment provider.

s5.title: 5. Cookies and similar technologies
s5.body: We use cookies for core website functionality, analytics and improving user experience. You can control cookie settings through your internet browser. Rejecting certain cookies may limit the availability of some website features.

s6.title: 6. Data sharing
s6.body: Data is shared only when necessary for service delivery: shipping, hosting, technical support and payment processing. We conclude appropriate data processing agreements with partners who process data on our behalf. We may also provide data to competent authorities when required by law.

s7.title: 7. Data retention periods
s7.body: We retain data only as long as necessary for the processing purpose and fulfillment of legal obligations. Data related to orders and invoices is retained within deadlines prescribed by applicable financial and tax regulations.

s8.title: 8. Data security
s8.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data against unauthorized access, alteration, loss or misuse. Although we apply appropriate safeguards, no internet data transfer can be absolutely secure.

s9.title: 9. User rights
s9.prefix: The user has the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing and object, as well as the right to data portability, in accordance with applicable regulations. You can submit your request to

s10.title: 10. Right to complaint
s10.body: If you believe your data is being processed contrary to regulations, you have the right to file a complaint with the competent personal data protection authority in the Republic of Serbia.

s11.title: 11. Privacy policy updates
s11.body: We reserve the right to update this policy to align with business operations and legal requirements. Any change takes effect on the date it is published on the website.

story.title: Our Story
story.headline: Meet a small, local brand from Belgrade
story.introLead: Hello, we are Vigor Fructus! We started producing dehydrated fruit because of our love for cocktails and the desire to create something truly natural, homemade and beautiful. Our team consists of two people with nearly two decades of experience in hospitality and working with clients across various industries. We know how to recognize our customers’ needs and turn them into a product we are proud of.
story.quote: If you are one of those people who feel disappointed when you order sparkling water and receive it without ice and a slice of lemon - you are in the right place!
story.quoteAuthor: Jelena & Danilo - founders of Vigor Fructus
story.beginningP1: Everything starts with procurement - we handpick fresh fruit, just like you would for yourself. Since we often use the whole fruit, the next step is thorough washing. Then we cut fruit into evenly sized slices to ensure consistent dehydration. Once everything is ready, the fruit is slowly dehydrated in professional dehydrators at low temperatures. The process takes hours, often a full day - we do that to remove the moisture while preserving flavor, aroma and nutritional value.
story.beginningP2: The result is crisp, beautifully dehydrated fruit, that looks like it came straight out of Pinterest and is ready to use straight away.
story.philosophyP1: We are not a factory and we don’t want to become one. Each batch is limited, every piece of fruit is prepared by hand. Every package carries hours of work and a genuine intention for you to enjoy it.
story.philosophyP2: Since we are eager to get our product to you as quickly as possible, orders in Belgrade over 2500 RSD placed before 10 AM are delivered the same day. For other cities in Serbia, we ship our product via courier service.
story.processTitle: From the orchard to your table
story.step1Desc: We hand-pick only the finest fruit from trusted suppliers across the region.
story.step2Desc: A careful low-temperature dehydration process preserves nutrients.
story.step3Desc: Eco-friendly packaging that protects the product and the environment.
story.ctaDesc: Discover why top bartenders and cocktail enthusiasts across Serbia choose us.
